legacyPrototype: spkf-local-prototype/1 remains metadata-only; its proved labels are not replay receipts
encoding: Bounded canonical JSON containing a manifest identity, sorted unique domain-qualified artifact descriptors with canonical base64 bytes, and optional Ed25519 signatures. No file paths, extraction or imported checker code.
manifest: psc-evidence-manifest/1 binds the semantic lock, knowledge roots and role-tagged archive artifacts. Caller pins its exact identity and semantic lock independently.
semanticLock: Capsules require psc-semantic-lock/1 and a trusted local semanticLockPolicy (expectedSemanticIdentityId, allowedAssumptions artifact IDs, allowedCapabilities, requiredToolchainRoles, optional resourceLimits). The verifier replays byte/graph/policy consistency before any claim checker. Knowledge context must bind the same lock. Arbitrary opaque or legacy prototype locks cannot satisfy this path.
validity: Exact consumer-selected semantic identity and scope; all dependency edges checked against six supported target kinds; iterative acyclic closure; explicit allowed assumptions; every referenced artifact rehashed under aggregate budgets.
claims: Proved/validated claims require a caller-selected claimId to exact subjectId, checkerId and claimClass mapping and fresh certificate-boundary replay. Unproved, empirical and advisory labels cannot meet required checked claims. Supersession and migration references carry no implicit preservation or context-widening authority.
provenance: Ed25519 verifies psc-archive-signature/1 plus exact manifest identity using caller-selected public keys and required signer IDs. Authentication does not imply semantic validity.
cli: node scripts/pscv-verify.mjs --capsule FILE --policy TRUSTED_LOCAL_POLICY; only built-in Core proof (with pinned local provider assets) and closed-literal Wasm binary checker adapters are selectable; full compiler and live registry are not required
outcome: Audit data only; never creates a CheckedCore handle or reports release acceptance. Unsupported certificates cannot be accepted as proved.
checkedLocally: Focused real integer-equality validator replay, actual Ed25519 verification, context/assumption/evidence/subject/tamper/budget/typed-edge rejection, and metadata-only CLI path. No new Lean theorem or global preservation claim.
remaining: Replay committed actual Lean proof slices and target validators through complete shipped checker assets
